{"script":"#!/bin/bash
set -e
ws=cpu_check_workspace
mkdir -p "$ws"
# 1. timestamp
date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" > "$ws"/timestamp.txt
# 2. system identification
{
 uname -a
 cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null || true
 hostnamectl 2>/dev/null || true
 cat /proc/version 2>/dev/null || true
} > "$ws"/system_info.raw
# 3. raw hardware enumeration
{
 lspci -vvv 2>/dev/null || true
 lsusb 2>/dev/null || true
 dmidecode -t processor 2>/dev/null || true
 cat /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null || true
} > "$ws"/hardware_listing.raw
# 4. isolate processor-related lines
grep -iE 'processor|model name|cpu|core id|physical id|socket' "$ws"/hardware_listing.raw > "$ws"/processors_extracted.txt || true
# 5. parse logical processor entries and tally
grep -iE '^processor[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*[0-9]+' "$ws"/processors_extracted.txt -o | sed -E 's/.*:[[:space:]]*//' | sort -n > "$ws"/cpu_identifiers.txt || true
wc -l < "$ws"/cpu_identifiers.txt > "$ws"/logical_counts.tmp || true
# 6. virtualization/container indicators within system_info.raw
if grep -iE 'docker|lxc|kvm|vmware|virtual|hypervisor|container|amazon|ec2' "$ws"/system_info.raw > "$ws"/virtualization_check.txt; then :; else echo "No indicators found" > "$ws"/virtualization_check.txt; fi
# 7. cross-reference and record mismatches/anomalies
> "$ws"/consistency_report.txt
if [ -s "$ws"/cpu_identifiers.txt ]; then
 ids=( $(cat "$ws"/cpu_identifiers.txt) )
 max=$(printf "%s\n" "${ids[@]}" | tail -n1 || true)
 if [ -z "$max" ]; then max=0; fi
 seq 0 "$max" | grep -v -x -F -f "$ws"/cpu_identifiers.txt > "$ws"/missing_ids.tmp || true
 if [ -s "$ws"/missing_ids.tmp ]; then
  echo "Missing logical processor IDs:" > "$ws"/consistency_report.txt
  cat "$ws"/missing_ids.tmp >> "$ws"/consistency_report.txt
 else
  echo "No missing logical processor IDs detected." > "$ws"/consistency_report.txt
 fi
else
 echo "No cpu identifiers found." > "$ws"/consistency_report.txt
fi
# 8. if mismatches exist, capture runtime context and append
if [ -s "$ws"/missing_ids.tmp ]; then
 uptime > "$ws"/runtime_snapshot.txt
 top -b -n1 | head -n20 >> "$ws"/runtime_snapshot.txt || true
 echo >> "$ws"/consistency_report.txt
 echo "Runtime snapshot saved in runtime_snapshot.txt" >> "$ws"/consistency_report.txt
fi
# 9. package all files into archive and record integrity note
tar -cf "$ws"/archive_prepared.tar -C "$ws" .
sha256sum "$ws"/archive_prepared.tar > "$ws"/archive_verification.txt || true
tar -tf "$ws"/archive_prepared.tar >> "$ws"/archive_verification.txt || true
# 10. final concise summary
num1=$(wc -l < "$ws"/cpu_identifiers.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
num2=$(nproc --all 2>/dev/null || echo "$num1")
{
 echo "timestamp: $(cat "$ws"/timestamp.txt)"
 echo "logical_identifiers_count: $num1"
 echo "nproc_count: $num2"
 echo "system_info: $ws/system_info.raw"
 echo "hardware_listing: $ws/hardware_listing.raw"
 echo "consistency_report: $ws/consistency_report.txt"
} > "$ws"/final_prep_summary.txt
# Output authoritative single CPU count (logical)
if command -v nproc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 nproc --all
else
 wc -l < "$ws"/cpu_identifiers.txt
fi
"}
